name: Viveiro (Spain)
description: Six horizontal stripes alternating white and blue.
history: The municipal flag of Viveiro is composed of six horizontal stripes of 1/6 of the width and equal in width to each other; its design is the same as that of the maritime province of Lugo, which centuries earlier was known as the maritime province of Viveiro, although the shade of blue is lighter on the Viveiro flag.
